related_work_id: {{story ID this bug or test task belongs to, or empty}}
status: {{ANALYSIS_DRAFT | ANALYSIS_APPROVED | IMPLEMENTATION_IN_PROGRESS | IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE | UNIT_TESTING_IN_PROGRESS | BUG_FOUND | BUG_FIX_IN_PROGRESS | BUG_FIXED | COMPLETE}}
waiting_for_human: {{null, or the reason the current stage stopped for the developer}}
analyzed_at_commit: {{Git revision (SHA) when /analyze-story wrote the plan, or null without Git}}
scope_anchors: {{standalone bug or test tasks only: file | failing test | stack trace | endpoint | class | function}}

production: {{path created or modified, recorded by /implement-story or /fix-bugs}}
tests: {{path created or modified, recorded by /unit-testing or /fix-bugs}}

unit_test.command: {{narrow test command: one file, class, or filter}}

coverage.command: {{command scoped to changed files, or NOT_CONFIGURED}}

coverage_goal: {{target for new or changed code, or NOT_CONFIGURED}}

defects.id: {{BUG_ID, or DEF-1, DEF-2 for defects found by /unit-testing}}
defects.evidence: {{failing test, build error, or stack trace location}}
defects.expected: {{expected behavior, or the AC it breaks}}

behaviors_to_cover: {{standalone test tasks only: B1 - behavior to prove}}
missing_facts: {{fact missing from the plan or context, or empty}}
